name: Micro Looper
description: An always-listening short looper: it loops what you just played as a soft bed, renews it as you play on, and can run the loop slower, lower, darker or backwards.

params.name: State
params.description: Listen only remembers what you play. Hold loops the last thing you played and keeps it for ever; if nothing was played yet it waits for the next phrase. Auto loops each new phrase in place of the last one and lets it die away.

params.name: Length
params.description: How much of what was just played becomes the loop. Short lengths stutter on a fragment; long ones repeat a whole phrase.

params.name: Speed
params.description: How fast and which way the loop plays. Half is an octave down and twice as long, Double an octave up, and the Reverse settings play it backwards. A change glides like tape.

params.name: Clock
params.description: The looper's own sample rate. Lower clocks record with less and less top, like an old sampler. Moving it while a loop plays drops the loop by a fourth, a fifth or octaves and stretches it to match.

params.name: Smear
params.description: Blends the plain loop into overlapping grains taken from around the same spot, which blurs the attacks and the point where the loop joins until it becomes a pad.

params.name: Fade
params.description: In Auto, how much of the loop is left after each time round. Low settings give a few fading repeats; at full the loop stays until the next phrase replaces it.

params.name: Drift
params.description: A slow random wobble in the loop's speed, and a slightly different starting point on each time round, so the loop never repeats quite the same way.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Takes highs off the loop so it sits behind what is played over it. The dry signal is not affected.

params.name: Spread
params.description: Widens the loop with two more reads from just ahead of and behind the playing point, added on the left and taken away on the right. In mono they cancel and leave the plain loop; the low end stays in the centre.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the loop.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. In outline a short hold-style looper with a variable sample clock, as the small micro-looper pedals work: a ring buffer written and read at a divided clock with band-limiting that follows it, a cross-faded loop join, and granular reading of the loop after Curtis Roads, Microsound (asynchronous granulation). Not a model of any unit.
